description: Save the scannable barcode images from an accesso order. Run locally, writes PNGs and returns their paths. Run remotely (hosted), returns the images inline by default, with a download link for any past the size cap; set inline to false for one expiring download link per barcode instead. Set inline to true to receive the images directly in any deployment.

indexes.description: Ticket `index` values to act on. Omit for every ticket on the order.

inline.description: true: return the images in the response. false: save them — files on a local install, expiring download links when hosted. Omitted: save locally, inline when hosted.

url.description: The accesso ticket link from the order-confirmation email. Optional when ACCESSO_TICKET_URL is set.

name: accesso_save_barcodes
